record.field:
Bake
Tool: High Temperature Oven
Ramp Rate: 75 C / hour
All parts will be baked to remove contamination absorbed into the surface of the ceramic. Position parts in the oven using ceramic fixtures. Segment 1 of the bake process will be a increase ramp rate of 75 degrees celcius per hour to the set point of 1000 degrees celcius. Segment 2 of the process will be a bake time of 2 hours at the set point of 1000 degrees celcius. Segment 3 of the process will be a decrease ramp rate 75 degrees celcius per hour to the set point of 20 degrees celcius. Segment 4 of the process will be a cool time of 1 minute at the set point of 20 degrees celcius.

div.root:
Bake
Tool: High Temperature Oven
Ramp Rate: 75 C / hour
All parts will be baked to remove contamination absorbed into the surface of the ceramic. Position parts in the oven using ceramic fixtures. Segment 1 of the bake process will be a increase ramp rate of 75 degrees celcius per hour to the set point of 1000 degrees celcius. Segment 2 of the process will be a bake time of 2 hours at the set point of 1000 degrees celcius. Segment 3 of the process will be a decrease ramp rate 75 degrees celcius per hour to the set point of 20 degrees celcius. Segment 4 of the process will be a cool time of 1 minute at the set point of 20 degrees celcius.
